device.model: Micro HD SE (System ID 10010A88, Edision GUI v.2484)
device.type: Compact DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet, USB PVR and external IR/LED eye
device.board: 10010A88 (bootloader version "M3511B 1.1.1", 8 MB SPI flash, 128 MB DDR3 M3503 revision B platform)
device.soc: ALi M3511B / M3503 rev B (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU DVB-S2 SoC reading chip ID 0x3503 rev 0x0001; seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0x86000200)
device.demod: internal ALi M3503 / M3511B DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503_0 at 0xB8028000)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko / Edision firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko / Edision
source.note: Archive AMIKO MicroHD SE_v.2484.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_micro_hd_se_v2484_app_starts.py, run_dump_micro_hd_se_v2484_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3511B 1.1.1") runs with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1416804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0x86000200 and maincode(AV) ("10010A882484", 13.73 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Micro HD SE (System ID 10010A88) firmware v.2.4.84 (2020-3-11) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3511B / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3511B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0x86000200, and an external 4-digit CH455 LED front-panel eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
